lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gill slits. Primary columns consist of three dominant centroids arranged vertically, with spatial intervals increasing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the lateral blob centroids to form a regular grid-like patterning across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (superior edge) to low-intensity shadow (inferior edge).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance pixel clusters scattered across the visible surface area of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin exhibits a high-frequency distribution of smaller-diameter spots compared to the flank, with increased density localized towards the distal tip and leading edge.
